title: Chat/set update list: receiveTypingIndicators has no cross-reference
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, the Chat/set Updating a Chat section lists receiveTypingIndicators as a supported patch key with no description or cross-reference. Unlike muted or muteUntil whose meaning is obvious, receiveTypingIndicators has a non-obvious server-side suppression effect. A reader scanning only Chat/set has no indication of what the field does or where to find it. A parenthetical cross-reference to the Chat object field definition (e.g., an anchor link) would remove the ambiguity.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
